item.title: Rails World 2026 (Sep 23-24 in Austin, TX)
item.description: Rails World 2026 is coming to Austin, TX! Join us on September 23 & 24 (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Here's the speaker lineup.
item.description: The fourth edition of Rails World is fast approaching with just over three months to go, so it’s time to meet the speakers who will join us this year in Austin, TX. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Rocky Mountain Ruby 2026 (Sep 28-29 in Boulder, CO)
item.description: Rocky Mountain Ruby is a single track conference devoted to the Ruby programming language which features technical presentations, community events and outdoor experiences, in beautiful Boulder, Colorado at one of the best times of year. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Tiny Ruby Conf (Oct 1 in Helsinki)
item.description: A tiny Ruby conference in Helsinki, Finland. Now in its second year. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: Kaigi on Rails 2026 (Oct 16-17 in Tokyo / Online)
item.description: Kaigi on Rails is a conference about web development centered on Ruby on Rails. Held at Bellesalle Shibuya Garden on October 16 (Fri) and 17 (Sat), 2026. (1 source: rubyweekly)
